content: Promoting positive health behaviors and psychological well-being is essential for individuals with diabetes to successfully meet their management goals and enhance their overall quality of life. Key components of this approach include diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES), which equips patients with the knowledge and skills necessary to manage their condition effectively. Medical nutrition therapy (MNT) plays a critical role in optimizing dietary habits to support glycemic control and overall health. Engaging in regular physical activity is another fundamental aspect, as it contributes to improved metabolic outcomes and cardiovascular health. After conducting a thorough and individualized health assessment, healthcare providers are advised to adopt a person-centered approach. This involves actively supporting patients in making informed decisions, setting realistic behavioral goals, and continuously monitoring their psychological and physical well-being.
